plainTranslation: Opposite tastes and values that attract. You're drawn to what you don't share. Failure mode: friction over whose way is right. Treat the difference as range, not a referendum.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
